entities.name: UDP-MurNAc-Ala-Glu ligase
observations: 481-aa query has 62.7% identity and 99.6% coverage to reviewed Clostridium botulinum MurD ligase A7FTY1; annotation is homology-supported, not direct experimental evidence for this query.
Pfam detects Mur_ligase, Mur_ligase_M, and Mur_ligase_C domains.
Homolog annotation: ATP-dependent addition of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu; EC 6.3.2.13; Mg2+ cofactor.
Homolog annotation places the enzyme in cytoplasm and implicates peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and cell-shape regulation.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: Homolog annotations place UDP-MurNAc-Ala-Glu ligase (MurD; EC 6.3.2.13) in bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan precursor synthesis.
